utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case IT-09-92-T, the Prosecutor versus Ratko Mladic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, thank you. Good morning to everyone. The Chamber was informed there are two preliminaries to be raised. Defence first. Mr. Stojanovic, is it about D394?

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's correct, Your Honours, yes. [Indiscernible] to the understanding of our dear Janet, we have the video-clip prepared as an exhibit. It is D394, as you have rightly said.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. That number was reserved. It had not been uploaded at that time. No objections from the Prosecution. If not, D394 is admitted into evidence. Thank you, Mr. Stojanovic. Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. GROOME
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. On the 22nd of May, 2013, the Prosecution filed a 92 bis motion for RM038. A decision on that matter is still pending. Due to some recent developments in the region, namely, the exhumation at the Tomasica mine the Prosecution is considering whether it might be more appropriate to call or tender this witness's evidence pursuant to 92 ter. I'm sending some staff to the region to further investigate some developments and I'm asking until next week to notify the Chamber whether we will maintain our 92 bis application or seek conversion to 92 ter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, to the extent we were about to give a decision on it, we will put it on hold for the time being.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Nothing else. Is the Prosecution ready to call its next witness, whose testimony will be heard in closed session. Mr. Shin.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours, counsel, and everyone in the courtroom. Yes, the Prosecution is prepared with the next witness who will be in closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Closed session and pseudonym. We turn into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Mr. Lukic, could you give us an indication as to how much time you'd still need tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Approximately as much as I used today. At least.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: At least. Well, the Chamber would appreciate if you would focus on what seems to be the core of the testimony of the witness rather than to extensively deal with matters that seem more in the margin of what the witness testifies about. Would you please consider that overnight and try to reduce the time you'd still need. We adjourn for the day, and we will resume tomorrow, Friday, the 1st of November, 2013, in this same courtroom, I. But I already can announce that it is expected that we would continue to hear testimony in closed session tomorrow. We stand adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 1st day of November, 2013, at 9.30 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.15 p.m.,
